title: Maharashtra Approves ₹45-Crore Eco-Nature Park with India's 1st AI Bird Monitoring Centre at Thane Creek
summary: Integrates AI acoustic sensors and automated camera tracking into coastal Ramsar wetland conservation.

blocks.title: 📰 4. 🌐 NATIONAL, STATE & INTERNATIONAL NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 Maharashtra Approves ₹45-Crore Eco-Nature Park with India's 1st AI Bird Monitoring Centre at Thane Creek. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Integrates AI acoustic sensors and automated camera tracking into coastal Ramsar wetland conservation.
Project Location: Thane Creek Flamingo Sanctuary shoreline (Bhandup Bird Park project, 20.09 hectares total, 0.35 hectares physical footprint).
Technology Footprint: Uses AI-based cameras and acoustic sensors across a 1.5-km stretch to track bird activity along the Central Asian Flyway.
Funding Allocation: ₹45 crore sanctioned from District Planning Committee special fund.
India's 1st dedicated flamingo sanctuary (Thane Creek, 2015) vs India's 101st Ramsar site (Glaw Lake, Arunachal Pradesh).
